item.title: From Tidyverse to Scverse – Post 4: qmd vs ipynb: Why Quarto Notebooks Are the Future
item.description: Jupyter notebooks are JSON with embedded images. Quarto notebooks are plain text. For version control, LLMs, and reproducibility, qmd wins.
